actions.action: Tap leaf over white paper to check for thrips
Patch-test spinosad on one leaf of each orchid type 48 hours ahead
Spray spinosad on leaf undersides, new growth and flowers every 5-7 days for 6 weeks
Alternate spinosad with insecticidal soap sprays
Release Amblyseius cucumeris or swirskii on foliage
Isolate worst-hit plants away from the others
Cut off spent flowers and damaged leaves and bag them

reason: The answer names thrips as the main cause and its predatory-mite program matches the beneficial-insect fix that worked; it even pauses sprays before releasing mites, so nothing in it is harmful.
